name: MDS International Congress（國際動作障礙學會年會）

en.name: MDS International Congress
en.relevance: The largest international meeting in movement disorders and a key venue for MSA clinical and pipeline presentations (Alterity presented ATH434 data at the 2025 congress).

name: International MSA Congress（Mission MSA）
relevance: MSA 專屬國際科學暨臨床大會，集結研究者、臨床醫師、產業與病友。下屆日期待官網公布。

en.name: International MSA Congress (Mission MSA)
en.relevance: The MSA-specific international scientific and clinical congress bringing together researchers, clinicians, industry and families. Next date to be announced.
